title: Spatio-temporally complementary feature propagation on graphs for longitudinal AADT estimation
abstract: arXiv:2609.29906v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The estimation of Annual Average Daily Traffic (AADT) is vital for transportation planning and infrastructure maintenance, yet obtaining accurate values for an entire urban network across multiple years remains challenging due to the high cost and spatial sparsity of physical sensors. This research proposes a novel spatio-temporally complementary feature propagation framework that leverages the strengths of two distinct data sources: spatially sparse but temporally dense loop detector data, and a spatially complete but temporally sparse macroscopic transportation model. The methodology highlights a feature propagation algorithm on directed graphs, formulated as a Poisson energy minimization considering residues. The standard binary adjacency matrix is replaced with flow ratio matrices to capture real-world vehicle turn ratios at intersections. translated_title: 基于图上时空互补特征传播的多年期年均日交通量（AADT）估计
translated_abstract: 年均日交通量（AADT）的估计对于交通规划和基础设施维护至关重要，然而由于物理传感器的高成本和空间稀疏性，获得整个城市网络多年期的准确数值仍然具有挑战性。本研究提出了一种新颖的时空互补特征传播框架，该框架充分利用了两种不同数据源的优势：空间稀疏但时间密集的环形检测器数据，以及空间完整但时间稀疏的宏观交通模型。该方法的核心是一种有向图上的特征传播算法，该算法被表述为考虑残差的泊松能量最小化问题。此外，用流量比矩阵取代标准的二值邻接矩阵，以捕捉交叉口处真实的车辆转弯比例。该算法在苏黎世市得到了验证，展现出高计算效率，并取得了……
tldr: 该研究提出一种时空互补特征传播框架，通过有向图上的泊松能量最小化和流量比矩阵，融合环形检测器数据与宏观交通模型两种互补数据源，实现高效准确的多年期城市路网AADT估计。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a spatio-temporally complementary feature propagation framework that leverages Poisson energy minimization on directed graphs with flow ratio matrices to fuse sparse-but-dense loop detector data with complete-but-sparse macroscopic transportation models, enabling efficient and accurate multi-year AADT estimation across urban networks.
